theory.title: Busca ropa y encuentra tu talla
theory.explanation: En una tienda puedes nombrar prendas, colores y tallas. Usa this con una prenda y these con varias: “this shirt”, “these shoes”. Para probarte algo, pregunta “Can I try this on?” o “Can I try these on?”. Puedes pedir una talla concreta con “Do you have this in medium?”. Para explicar cómo queda, di “It's too small” o “They're comfortable”.
theory.tip: En inglés británico se dice “trousers” para pantalones y “jumper” para jersey. “A pair of” se usa con prendas que tienen dos partes, como shoes, socks y trousers.

content.audioTranscript: Hello. Can I help you? Yes, I'm looking for a jacket. What colour would you like? A blue one, please. This one is nice. Do you have it in medium? Yes, here you are. Can I try it on? Of course. The changing room is over there. Thank you. Oh, this jacket is too small. The sleeves are short. Have you got another one? Yes, try this one. That's better. It's very comfortable. Great. And where are the black trainers? They're next to the shoes. I'd like to try them too. Of course. I think I'll take the jacket. Wonderful. Thank you.
